title: Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next
abstract: arXiv:2611.12200v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A

translated_title: 通过评估接下来会发生什么，学习基于世界模型的行动
translated_abstract: 稀疏的终端奖励几乎无法告诉智能体其各个步骤的价值。许多缺失的信息隐含在环境的动态之中，因为每一次状态转移都可能在奖励到来之前很久就改变了成功的条件。在真实转移上训练的世界模型可以学会预测每个动作改变了什么，但预测出的观测本身并不能表明成功的可能性是否有所提高。在二值终端奖励的情况下，PPO 的评论家通过估计当前策略的成功概率来做出这一判断，但仅限于智能体实际到达的状态。我们的方法 WM-PPO 优雅地将这两者结合在一起：对于策略采样的每个动作——无论是否被执行——世界模型都会预测下一个观测，而评论家则对该预测的后继状态进行估值。在策略通道中，这些值之间的比较为策略提供了辅助优势；在价值通道中，它们的均值则作为评论家的辅助目标。……
tldr: WM-PPO 将世界模型与 PPO 评论家相结合：对策略采样的每个动作，由世界模型预测其后续观测并由评论家估值，从而为策略提供辅助优势、为评论家提供辅助目标，以更好地应对稀疏终端奖励问题。
en_tdlr: WM-PPO elegantly couples a world model with PPO's critic: for every action the policy samples, the world model predicts the successor state and the critic values it, providing auxiliary advantages for the policy and auxiliary targets for the critic to learn effectively from sparse terminal rewards.
